description: Counter Terrorism and Investigation Division - Sri Lanka Police - Amend to the Extra Gazette No. 2230/15 of 04.06.2021
categorisation: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory matter involving an amendment to a place of detention under the Prevention of Terrorism (Temporary Provisions) Act. It constitutes a regulatory action (notification under Section 9 of the Act) rather than a government personnel or structural change. While it mentions the President by name, this is in his capacity as the authority issuing a legal notification, not as a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment. The core content is about modifying legal detention provisions, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
